modified_files.description: Added 10 new XBRL concept entries mapping InterestExpense variants (5 tags), IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit variants (2 tags), and pretax_income variants (3 tags) to canonical names interest_expense, income_tax_expense, pretax_income. All with Unit: USD, PeriodType: duration, Priorities 1-5.

Updated dictionary assertion from 20→23 concepts, added 3 new required concepts (interest_expense, income_tax_expense, pretax_income), and added 5 new test functions: TestM6cT1InterestTaxTagsMapped, TestM6cT1ExcludedInterestTaxTags, TestM6cT1UnitMustBeUSD, TestM6cT1PriorityOrderInterestTax, TestM6cT1DedupeOneRowPerConceptAndPeriod.
Updated assertion from concepts != 20 to concepts != 23, with comment documenting the 20 original + 3 M6c-T1 additions.
Updated xbrl_concept_map concept count from 20 to 23, noting the 3 M6c-T1 concepts from migration 019.

new_files.description: Contains 3 INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (xbrl_concept, canonical_name) DO NOTHING statements for interest_expense, income_tax_expense, and pretax_income. No DDL, no backfill, no dynamic SQL. Idempotent by design.

integrity_risks.reversal_method: DELETE FROM xbrl_concept_map WHERE xbrl_concept IN ('interest_expense','income_tax_expense','pretax_income')

migration_019_analysis.rationale: Uses existing unique constraint, idempotent DO NOTHING, no DDL, reversible via targeted DELETE. No backfill required.

parser_canonicalzer.rationale: All changes are entries in the concept dictionary (concepts.go). The EDGAR parser, normalizer, and dedupe logic in normalize.go are not modified.

classification.summary: Scan complete: no exposed secrets (gitleaks: no leaks found), no risky SQL, catalog-only changes, no dependency changes. All findings are low-info or neutral. Migration 019 is safe: static SQL, constraint-matched ON CONFLICT, reversible.
